PORT.name: PORT
PORT.description: Port the container listens on. Injected by Railway; the entrypoint maps it to the OpenBB server's OPENBB_API_PORT.

TZ.name: TZ
TZ.description: Container timezone (IANA name), used for logs and generated output.

OPENBB_API_AUTH.name: OPENBB_API_AUTH
OPENBB_API_AUTH.description: Enable HTTP Basic auth on the endpoints (true/false). Leave false for open access on a private project. The username/password below are auto-filled so you can deploy one-click and change them later.

OPENBB_API_USERNAME.name: OPENBB_API_USERNAME
OPENBB_API_USERNAME.description: Username for the optional HTTP Basic gate (used only when OPENBB_API_AUTH=true). Has a sensible default so you can deploy one-click and change it later.

OPENBB_API_PASSWORD.name: OPENBB_API_PASSWORD
OPENBB_API_PASSWORD.description: Password for the optional HTTP Basic gate (used only when OPENBB_API_AUTH=true). A unique value is generated automatically on deploy. Change it any time from the Variables tab.

FMP_API_KEY.name: FMP_API_KEY
FMP_API_KEY.description: Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API key — the premium equity/ETF/FX source. Paste your key to enable FMP calls; leave empty to use keyless providers (yfinance) and add it later from the Variables tab. Get one: https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/developer/docs. Placeholder, replace with a real key before using FMP.

INTRINIO_API_KEY.name: INTRINIO_API_KEY
INTRINIO_API_KEY.description: Intrinio API key — fundamental & market data. Paste your key to enable Intrinio calls; leave empty and add it later from the Variables tab. Placeholder, replace with a real key before using Intrinio.

FRED_API_KEY.name: FRED_API_KEY
FRED_API_KEY.description: FRED (St. Louis Fed) API key — free macro/economic series (CPI, GDP series, rate curves). Paste your key to enable FRED calls; leave empty and add it later from the Variables tab. Free tier: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html. Placeholder, replace with a real key before using FRED.
